root_cause.text: The `ntfs_fill_super()` function fails to NUL-terminate the converted UTF-8 volume label stored in `sbi->volume.label` after calling `utf16s_to_utf8s()`, which does not append a trailing NUL, leading to a potential out-of-bounds read when the label is later printed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `fs/ntfs3/super.c` adds explicit NUL-termination to `sbi->volume.label` after the `utf16s_to_utf8s()` call, clamping the index to `sizeof(sbi->volume.label) - 1` if the converted string fills the entire buffer.
